_about: Per-Drake-build field binding. Copy to binding.json and fill in on the VM. INPUT/FOCUS: each field maps a LOGICAL name (what Fynn sends) to how the agent plants a caret. On Drake 2025 the grid is a custom canvas with NO focusable OS elements, so the only reliable focus is a physical mouse CLICK — set "click_xy": [x, y] (window-relative pixels, the field's center). If omitted, the agent clicks the center of "ocr_box". field_no/tab_index (keyboard nav) are fallbacks for builds where they work. The agent tries automation_id, then click_xy, then ocr_box-center, then field_no, then tab_index. READ-BACK: Drake exposes no programmatic value, so verification is either OCR of a screen crop ("ocr_box": [x, y, w, h] window-relative pixels — capture with `agent.py shoot`, read the box off the PNG) or the human screenshot floor. TIP: one `shoot` PNG gives you BOTH click_xy (the box's center) and ocr_box (the box's rectangle).
_main_window_min_note: Minimum [width, height] for the window the agent binds to. Drake's Live Chat overlay is a topmost ~84x84 window in the same process; this size floor makes the agent pick the real data-entry frame instead. Confirm with `agent.py probe` / `shoot`, which print the bound window's title + size.
_send_vk_packet_note: How literal characters are injected. false = real virtual-key + scan-code events (what DOS-heritage apps like Drake require). true = pywinauto's default Unicode 'packet' method, which Drake IGNORES (caret sits in the field, nothing types). Leave false for Drake. CONFIRMED working on Drake Tax 2025.
_tesseract_cmd_note: Full path to tesseract.exe for OCR read-back if it's not on PATH, e.g. "C:\\Program Files\\Tesseract-OCR\\tesseract.exe". Install the Tesseract binary (UB-Mannheim Windows build) plus `pip install pytesseract pillow`. Leave null if tesseract is on PATH.
_enter_index_note: enter_index (per field) = the field's position in Drake's Enter-key navigation order from the first field on screen-open, empirically mapped. W-2 confirmed 2026-07-28: employer_ein=0 -> employer_name=1 -> box1_wages=2 -> box2_fed_wh=3. Sequential entry types down this order pressing Enter to advance; ocr_box gives the pixel rectangle to OCR-verify each value.

capabilities._note: read_back_method: how the agent reads a box back. On Drake 2025 ALL programmatic reads are dead — UIA (0 values), win32 (0 inner fields), clipboard (copy returns nothing + breaks focus). Options: 'ocr' (screenshot a per-field ocr_box crop and OCR it — approximate, needs pytesseract + Tesseract + calibrated ocr_box; set can_read_field_values=true and expect confidence<1.0), 'screenshot' (no automated value — a human verifies the capture; the honest floor), or 'none' (no verification — Fynn's honesty gate keeps live OFF). 'uia'/'clipboard' are kept for other software / a future build.

navigation._note: Key chords in pywinauto send_keys() syntax. IMPORTANT: Ctrl chords are TOXIC on Drake's canvas — Ctrl+A/Ctrl+C break field focus and pop the 'fields must contain data' modal (empirically confirmed). So field_clear is Ctrl-free and headsdown_toggle defaults to empty. Calibrate against your build.
